name: Forest Shrine Clearing
author: voodoo573
description: A woodland clearing crossed by a dirt path. At its centre a ring of eight standing stones surrounds a small stone altar with a glowing gem; a lily pond sits to the north-west, and dense tree canopy fills the edges for cover. 24 x 18 squares at 64 px per 5-ft square.
summary: Woodland clearing with standing-stone shrine, pond and path.
credits: Original battle map created for the Hearth Community repository by voodoo573 (2026), drawn procedurally with a Python/PIL script; no third-party art used. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
